title: Open 21.4
creator: CrossFit Games
description: Immediately after 21.3, seven minutes to build to a max-load complex of 1 deadlift, 1 clean, 1 hang clean and 1 jerk, unbroken. Score is the heaviest complex completed. Foundations swapped the jerk for a push press and started with a stick.
